neighbours.label: the word 'stuck' (and 'St|uck'); synonyms such as trapped, lost or jammed stay low
fire: Whenever I get stuck on a puzzle, I take a short walk.
Stuck in traffic again, he called to say he would be late.
If you feel stuck in your career, talk to a mentor.
Our team was stuck on the same bug for two days.
Stuck indoors by the rain, the kids built a fort.
Don't stay stuck on one question during the exam.
The door is stuck, so use the side entrance.
I got stuck halfway through the second chapter.
quiet: Whenever I get tired of a puzzle, I take a short walk.
Delayed in traffic again, he called to say he would be late.
If you feel bored in your career, talk to a mentor.
Our team was busy with the same bug for two days.
Kept indoors by the rain, the kids built a fort.
Don't spend too long on one question during the exam.
The door is locked, so use the side entrance.
I got lost halfway through the second chapter.
